info.description: The Meeting Cancellation API allows users to efficiently handle the cancellation of meetings. Designed primarily for event organizers and administrative personnel, this endpoint facilitates the management of scheduled meetings by allowing them to cancel existing ones. This action helps in maintaining accurate scheduling and resource allocation. Typical consumers include companies managing appointments or collaborative team environments where meeting logistics need to be adjusted dynamically.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a scheduled meeting, effectively removing it from the calendar. Once canceled, all participants will be notified accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for canceling a meeting. It should contain the meeting identifier and any relevant information related to the cancellation process.

200.description: The meeting cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelRequest.description: The request body for cancelling a meeting operation.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Meeting Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the cancellation operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier representing the result of the cancellation.

state.description: The current state of the meeting after the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time for the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for successful cancellation of a meeting.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit of the cancellation process.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the cancel operation, measured in milliseconds.
